The model failed to correctly perceive the temporal order of rope rendering, likely due to misalignment of visual onset cues or misattribution of color to the wrong rope in sequence.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly perceive the temporal order in which the ropes were drawn. This indicates a perception-level error in tracking the drawing sequence, which then led to a logically consistent but factually incorrect reasoning chain. The root failure lies in misordering visual events, not in color identification or logical inference per se.
